title: ‘It feels like a calling’: The internet vigilantes who weaponise kindness
titleZh: 「这像一种使命」：把善意变成武器的网络义警

sentence_pairs.en: Social media is often seen as a mirror for human cruelty.
sentence_pairs.cn: 社交媒体常被看作人性之恶的一面镜子。

sentence_pairs.en: One man built a TikTok army of 500,000 to fix it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 有一个人组建了一支50万人的 TikTok 大军来改变这一点。

sentence_pairs.en: Their weapon: kindness.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们的武器是：善意。

sentence_pairs.en: Every day, Laura Tigeleiro of Staten Island, New York, would open TikTok to a sea of hatred.
sentence_pairs.cn: 每天，纽约州斯塔滕岛的劳拉·蒂格莱罗（Laura Tigeleiro）打开 TikTok，扑面而来的都是仇恨。

sentence_pairs.en: "Everyone was making fun of my eye," she says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "大家都在取笑我的眼睛，"她说。

sentence_pairs.en: Tigeleiro has multiple sclerosis, an autoimmune disease that's made one of her piercing blue eyes droop sideways.
sentence_pairs.cn: 蒂格莱罗患有多发性硬化症，一种自身免疫疾病，让她一只澄澈的蓝眼睛向一侧下垂。

sentence_pairs.en: "I just wanted to share healthy recipes, and maybe make some friends," she says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我只是想分享一些健康食谱，也许交几个朋友，"她说。

sentence_pairs.en: "But they said terrible things.
sentence_pairs.cn: "可他们说了一些很难听的话。

sentence_pairs.en: It really hurt." Then, last March, her phone exploded, and everything changed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 真的很受伤。"然后，去年三月，她的手机爆了，一切都变了。

sentence_pairs.en: One of her videos had gone viral, with over 15,000 friendly comments.
sentence_pairs.cn: 她的一条视频走红了，收到一万五千多条友善的评论。

sentence_pairs.en: "I didn't know what was going on.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我不知道发生了什么。

sentence_pairs.en: I was shocked," says Tigeleiro.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我惊呆了，"蒂格莱罗说。

sentence_pairs.en: Days later, she figured it out: she was under attack by the Kindness Mob.
sentence_pairs.cn: 几天后她才弄明白：她被"善意暴徒"（Kindness Mob）"围攻"了。

sentence_pairs.en: The Kindness Mob is a TikTok channel run by Tyler Brickley, a digital marketer from Kansas City, US, who started the project in 2023.
sentence_pairs.cn: "善意暴徒"是一个 TikTok 频道，运营者是美国堪萨斯城的数字营销人泰勒·布里克利（Tyler Brickley），他在2023年发起了这个项目。

sentence_pairs.en: "It's a form of trolling," he says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "这是一种'黑'人的形式，"他说。

sentence_pairs.en: Every day, Brickley points his half-a-million followers at someone who's being bullied or overlooked, and has them flood the target with kind comments.
sentence_pairs.cn: 每天，布里克利都会把这50万粉丝的火力对准某个正在被欺凌或被忽视的人，让他们用善意的评论把对方淹没。

sentence_pairs.en: "We're hijacking the machinery of online harassment," like coordination and anonymity, and using them for benevolence.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我们是在劫持网络骚扰的机器"——比如组织性和匿名性——然后把这些机器用来行善。

sentence_pairs.en: "And I gotta say, it works."
sentence_pairs.cn: "而且我得说，真的管用。"

sentence_pairs.en: There's something more interesting here than people being nice.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这里有些比"人们对人和气"更有意思的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: When the mob descends, the bullying often stops, sometimes forever.
sentence_pairs.cn: 当"暴徒"们从天而降，欺凌常常就此停止，有时是永远停止。

sentence_pairs.en: It's an example of what scholars call "social contagion theory", where positive or negative behaviour spreads from person to person like a virus.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是学者们所说的"社会传染理论"的一个例子：正面或负面的行为，会像病毒一样在人与人之间传播。

sentence_pairs.en: Leading researchers tell me Brickley's movement demonstrates how we might change the tide not just of an internet platform, but perhaps an entire culture.
sentence_pairs.cn: 多位顶尖研究者告诉我，布里克利的运动证明了：我们或许不仅能扭转一个互联网平台的风向，甚至可能扭转一整个文化。

sentence_pairs.en: "This type of online behaviour is wonderful, but of course, we need more," says Nicholas Christakis, professor of social and natural science at Yale University.
sentence_pairs.cn: "这类网上行为很美好，当然，我们需要更多，"耶鲁大学社会与自然科学教授尼古拉斯·克里斯塔基斯（Nicholas Christakis）说。

sentence_pairs.en: "It's possible that this Kindness Mob is creating an opportunity for people to take initial steps towards the more substantial contributions we'll have to make if we're going to correct the deficiencies in our society."
sentence_pairs.cn: "这支善意暴徒有可能正在创造一个机会，让人们迈出最初的一步，走向那些更有分量的贡献——如果我们要纠正这个社会的种种缺陷，这些贡献是必须的。"

sentence_pairs.en: "On 1 January 2023, I was thinking about momentum," says Brickley.
sentence_pairs.cn: "2023年1月1日，我在琢磨'势头'这件事，"布里克利说。

sentence_pairs.en: "It just feels like a lot of people leaving negative comments don't really mean it".
sentence_pairs.cn: "很多留下恶评的人，感觉并不是真的恶意"。

sentence_pairs.en: They're following a crowd.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他们只是在跟风。

sentence_pairs.en: "That was the lightbulb moment," Brickley says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "那就是灵光一现的时刻，"布里克利说。

sentence_pairs.en: "I thought, what if I start a channel where I get 10 people in a little club, and we flood the comments with positivity to tip the scales?"
sentence_pairs.cn: "我想，要是我开一个频道，拉10个人组成一个小俱乐部，用善意的评论去刷屏，会怎么样？"

sentence_pairs.en: Ten was modest.
sentence_pairs.cn: 十个人，只是个小起点。

sentence_pairs.en: By Brickley's count, he's organised 350 mobs, and the average video gets 1,000 comments.
sentence_pairs.cn: 据布里克利统计，他已经组织了350次"围攻"，平均每条视频能收到1000条评论。

sentence_pairs.en: Successful posts generate tens of thousands or more, and pull in millions of views.
sentence_pairs.cn: 成功的帖子能收到数以万计甚至更多的评论，并带来数百万的浏览量。

sentence_pairs.en: In one recent mob, the celebrity socialite Paris Hilton joined in.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在最近的一次行动中，名媛帕丽斯·希尔顿（Paris Hilton）也加入了。

sentence_pairs.en: Often, the mobsters discover they love the account they're attacking and stick around.
sentence_pairs.cn: 很多时候，这些"暴徒"会发现自己喜欢上了被"围攻"的账号，从此留了下来。

sentence_pairs.en: It changes people's lives.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这会改变人的生活。

sentence_pairs.en: Renee Penick, a grandmother from Ohio, US, says she was at her husband's hospital bed when the Mob visited.
sentence_pairs.cn: 美国俄亥俄州一位祖母蕾妮·佩尼克（Renee Penick）说，暴徒们"造访"她时，她正守在丈夫的病床边。

sentence_pairs.en: It gave her strength in a crisis and built an entire community around her videos.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那在危机中给了她力量，并为她的视频建立起一整个社群。

sentence_pairs.en: Nocturne, a musician from upstate New York, says the mob brought her so many new fans that she's about to go on tour.
sentence_pairs.cn: 来自纽约州北部的音乐人诺克恩（Nocturne）说，那次"围攻"给她带来了太多新粉丝，她即将开启巡演。

sentence_pairs.en: After Brickley turned his army on Tigeleiro, she gained so many new followers that TikTok started paying her.
sentence_pairs.cn: 布里克利的大军转向蒂格莱罗之后，她涨了太多粉，TikTok 都开始给她付钱了。

sentence_pairs.en: She says she made enough money to buy her family a much-needed new car.
sentence_pairs.cn: 她说自己赚到的钱足够给家里买一辆急需的新车。

sentence_pairs.en: "I dreamed of a better life, and Tyler gave me that chance," Tigeleiro says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我梦想过更好的生活，泰勒给了我这个机会，"蒂格莱罗说。

sentence_pairs.en: "I owe it all to him, but he'd disagree with that."
sentence_pairs.cn: "这一切都归功于他——但他不会同意这个说法。"

sentence_pairs.en: Brickley, meanwhile, goes out of his way to keep the work hidden from the Kindness Mob's targets.
sentence_pairs.cn: 而布里克利则刻意让这一切避开"善意暴徒"行动对象的视线。

sentence_pairs.en: "We're not the point of the story.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我们不是故事的重点。

sentence_pairs.en: The point is to remove the distraction, to get all these hateful comments out of the way so the person's content can shine through."
sentence_pairs.cn: 重点是移走干扰，把那些恶评统统清开，让这个人的内容得以发光。"

sentence_pairs.en: When people talk to me about the darkness that's so familiar online, they describe the internet like a mirror – a system that simply reflects the natural cruelty of the human spirit.
sentence_pairs.cn: 当人们跟我谈起网络上那种再熟悉不过的黑暗时，他们把互联网描述成一面镜子——一个只会映照人性天然之恶的系统。

sentence_pairs.en: However, Christakis says that's a misread of what's happening on social media.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然而克里斯塔基斯说，这是对社交媒体上真实情况的误读。

sentence_pairs.en: "Yes, we humans evolved to be mendacious and tribal, and evil and harmful," he says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "是的，我们人类在演化中确实变得虚伪而部落化，会作恶、会伤害人，"他说。

sentence_pairs.en: "But equally, we evolved to be good; to manifest qualities of love and friendship, and kindness and teaching."
sentence_pairs.cn: "但同样地，我们也在演化中变得善良；我们会展现爱、友谊、善意与互助。"

sentence_pairs.en: As Christakis argues in his book Blueprint: The Evolutionary Origins of a Good Society, these good qualities must outweigh the bad in our natural state.
sentence_pairs.cn: 正如克里斯塔基斯在《蓝图：好社会的演化起源》（Blueprint: The Evolutionary Origins of a Good Society）一书中所论证的，在自然状态下，这些好的品质必定压过坏的。

sentence_pairs.en: Otherwise, humans would have learned to live in isolation rather than in societies where we're constantly exposed to each other.
sentence_pairs.cn: 否则，人类早该学会离群索居，而不是生活在彼此不断互动的社会里。

sentence_pairs.en: "Social media hijacks these ancient, friendly, pro-social qualities", he says, both by introducing anonymity, and through algorithms that highlight conflict and strife to drive engagement and keep us staring at our phones.
sentence_pairs.cn: "社交媒体劫持了这些古老的、友善的、亲社会的品质"，他说——一方面引入匿名，另一方面用算法放大冲突与争斗来驱动用户参与，让我们盯着手机不放。

sentence_pairs.en: In other words, Christakis says the Kindness Mob's work is sidestepping the perverse influence of social media and encouraging a more "natural" kind of pleasant interaction.
sentence_pairs.cn: 换句话说，克里斯塔基斯认为，善意暴徒做的事，是在绕开社交媒体的扭曲影响，鼓励一种更"自然"的愉快互动。

sentence_pairs.en: After all, most adults wouldn't waltz into a stranger's house and insult their appearance, the way so many people do in the comments of a video.
sentence_pairs.cn: 毕竟，大多数成年人不会径直闯进陌生人的家里羞辱对方的长相——可那么多人每天在网上就这么干。

sentence_pairs.en: It could have positive knock-on effects.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这可能带来正向的连锁效应。

sentence_pairs.en: " We showed experimentally that you can create these cascades of kindness," says Christakis of his research.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我们用实验证明：你可以制造出善意的级联，"克里斯塔基斯谈到他的研究时说。

sentence_pairs.en: "You are kind to Susie, Susie's kind to Betty, and Betty's kind to Tommy.
sentence_pairs.cn: "你对苏茜好，苏茜就对贝蒂好，贝蒂就对汤米好。

sentence_pairs.en: So, how Betty treats Tommy depends on how you treated Susie, even though neither you nor I ever interacted with Betty or Tommy."
sentence_pairs.cn: 于是，贝蒂怎么对待汤米，取决于你怎么对待苏茜——尽管你和我都从未跟贝蒂或汤米打过交道。"

sentence_pairs.en: On an internet that can seem filled with nastiness, Christakis says the Kindness Mob has stumbled onto a solution that's backed by science.
sentence_pairs.cn: 在一片看似乌烟瘴气的互联网上，克里斯塔基斯说，善意暴徒误打误撞发现了一个真正重要的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: When people stop engaging with trolls and connect with each other instead, research shows that trolls may change their behaviour.
sentence_pairs.cn: 研究表明，当人们不再与喷子纠缠、转而彼此联结时，喷子们可能会改变自己的行为。

sentence_pairs.en: Someone, however, needs to carry the burden of orchestrating all the kindness.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然而，总得有人承担起调度这一切善意的重担。

sentence_pairs.en: In September 2025, Brickley's following grew from 30,000 to 200,000 all at once.
sentence_pairs.cn: 2025年9月，布里克利的粉丝数一夜之间从3万涨到20万。

sentence_pairs.en: "It was very exciting," he says, but it came with a toll.
sentence_pairs.cn: "非常振奋，"他说，但代价也随之而来。

sentence_pairs.en: "One day I was staring at my phone, and I thought, I just can't do this."
sentence_pairs.cn: "有一天我盯着手机，心想：我真的做不动了。"

sentence_pairs.en: The project isn't lucrative.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这个项目并不赚钱。

sentence_pairs.en: TikTok pays accounts with big followings, but in August, Brickley says he made $39 (about £29).
sentence_pairs.cn: TikTok 会给大账号付钱，但布里克利说，八月份他只赚了39美元（约29英镑）。

sentence_pairs.en: Instead, he's driven by a sense of personal responsibility.
sentence_pairs.cn: 驱动他的，是一种个人责任感。

sentence_pairs.en: Every day, fans nominate anywhere from 20 to 100 people for potential mobs with a form on the Kindness Mob's website .
sentence_pairs.cn: 每天，粉丝通过"善意暴徒"网站上的一张表格，提名20到100个潜在的"围攻"对象。

sentence_pairs.en: But the audience's attention is finite and Brickley only posts one mob a day.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但受众的注意力是有限的，布里克利每天只发一次"围攻"。

sentence_pairs.en: "It means there are 20 people showing up on my doorstep every day," Brickley says, all of them suffering from deliberate cruelty.
sentence_pairs.cn: "这意味着每天有20个人站在我家门口，"布里克利说，他们都在遭受蓄意的残忍对待。

sentence_pairs.en: "And I have to turn 19 of them away, and the next day there's 20 more." Eventually, the burden was so overwhelming he had to take a few months off.
sentence_pairs.cn: "而我不得不把其中19个拒之门外，第二天，又来20个。"最终，这份重担压得他不得不休息了几个月。

sentence_pairs.en: To release some of the emotional weight, Brickley had to reframe the project in his mind.
sentence_pairs.cn: 为了卸下一些情绪重量，布里克利不得不在心里重新定义这个项目。

sentence_pairs.en: He couldn't directly help each person in need, but the mob could pick one each day to use as a lesson.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他无法直接帮助每一个需要帮助的人，但暴徒们可以每天挑一个人，当作一堂课来对待。

sentence_pairs.en: He also organised some volunteers to share logistical work.
sentence_pairs.cn: 他还组织了一些志愿者来分担事务性工作。

sentence_pairs.en: "I've been studying internet culture professionally for two decades, and things like this have a very limited shelf life," says professor Alice Marwick, director of research at the Data and Society Research Institute.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我研究互联网文化已经二十年了，是拿它当职业来做的，这类事情的生命周期非常有限，"数据与社会研究所（Data and Society Research Institute）研究主任、教授爱丽丝·马威克（Alice Marwick）说。

sentence_pairs.en: "Usually, the person behind them gets burned out in a year or two and it goes away."
sentence_pairs.cn: "通常，这类项目背后的人会在一两年内被耗竭，然后它就消失了。"

sentence_pairs.en: Social media platforms bear a huge responsibility for user behaviour, Marwick says, but you can't just blame algorithms.
sentence_pairs.cn: 马威克说，社交媒体平台对用户行为负有巨大责任，但你不能只怪算法。

sentence_pairs.en: "What we need is a larger shift in social norms around how we treat people online," she says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我们需要的是社会规范的更大转变——关于我们该如何在网上对待他人，"她说。

sentence_pairs.en: "I like the idea of amplifying pro-social behaviour online.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我喜欢放大网上亲社会行为的想法。

sentence_pairs.en: Whether or not it moves the needle much remains to be seen."
sentence_pairs.cn: 至于它能否真正撬动局面，还有待观察。"

sentence_pairs.en: Last autumn, Brickley had back surgery.
sentence_pairs.cn: 去年秋天，布里克利接受了背部手术。

sentence_pairs.en: "When I woke up, my wife was being all cagey and weird.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我醒来时，我妻子神神秘秘、怪怪的。

sentence_pairs.en: Finally, she said, 'Just check your phone'," he says.
sentence_pairs.cn: 最后她说：'你自己看手机吧'，"他说。

sentence_pairs.en: She'd stepped outside the hospital room to post a TikTok.
sentence_pairs.cn: 她溜出病房，发了一条 TikTok。

sentence_pairs.en: Brickley himself was being mobbed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 布里克利自己被"围攻"了。

sentence_pairs.en: "There were like 1,000 comments.
sentence_pairs.cn: "大概有1000条评论。

sentence_pairs.en: I was reading through them, just sobbing.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我一条条读过去，一直在哭。

sentence_pairs.en: Ugly crying," Brickley says.
sentence_pairs.cn: 哭得稀里哗啦，"布里克利说。

sentence_pairs.en: "I just realised this is real.
sentence_pairs.cn: "我只是意识到：这一切是真的。

sentence_pairs.en: It can really help.
sentence_pairs.cn: 它真的能帮到人。

sentence_pairs.en: So many things crystallised for me in that moment." He's gone back to the comments time and again for strength.
sentence_pairs.cn: 那一刻，很多事情在我心里豁然开朗。"此后他一次次回到那些评论里汲取力量。

sentence_pairs.en: "It feels like a calling," Brickley says.
sentence_pairs.cn: "这感觉像是一种使命，"布里克利说。

sentence_pairs.en: "The Kindness Mob is just one step.
sentence_pairs.cn: "善意暴徒只是第一步。

sentence_pairs.en: But kindness, for everyone, always, feels like a good place to start.
sentence_pairs.cn: 而善意——给每个人的、永远的善意——感觉像是一个很好的起点。"

sentences.en: The Kindness Mob is a TikTok channel run by Tyler Brickley, a digital marketer from Kansas City, US, who started the project in 2023.
sentences.cn: "善意暴徒"是一个 TikTok 频道，运营者是美国堪萨斯城的数字营销人泰勒·布里克利（Tyler Brickley），他在2023年发起了这个项目。

sentences.en: "It's a form of trolling," he says.
sentences.cn: "这是一种'黑'人的形式，"他说。

sentences.en: Every day, Brickley points his half-a-million followers at someone who's being bullied or overlooked, and has them flood the target with kind comments.
sentences.cn: 每天，布里克利都会把这50万粉丝的火力对准某个正在被欺凌或被忽视的人，让他们用善意的评论把对方淹没。

sentences.en: "We're hijacking the machinery of online harassment," like coordination and anonymity, and using them for benevolence.
sentences.cn: "我们是在劫持网络骚扰的机器"——比如组织性和匿名性——然后把这些机器用来行善。

sentences.en: "And I gotta say, it works."
sentences.cn: "而且我得说，真的管用。"

sentences.en: There's something more interesting here than people being nice.
sentences.cn: 这里有些比"人们对人和气"更有意思的东西。

sentences.en: When the mob descends, the bullying often stops, sometimes forever.
sentences.cn: 当"暴徒"们从天而降，欺凌常常就此停止，有时是永远停止。

sentences.en: It's an example of what scholars call "social contagion theory", where positive or negative behaviour spreads from person to person like a virus.
sentences.cn: 这是学者们所说的"社会传染理论"的一个例子：正面或负面的行为，会像病毒一样在人与人之间传播。

sentences.en: Leading researchers tell me Brickley's movement demonstrates how we might change the tide not just of an internet platform, but perhaps an entire culture.
sentences.cn: 多位顶尖研究者告诉我，布里克利的运动证明了：我们或许不仅能扭转一个互联网平台的风向，甚至可能扭转一整个文化。

sentences.en: "This type of online behaviour is wonderful, but of course, we need more," says Nicholas Christakis, professor of social and natural science at Yale University.
sentences.cn: "这类网上行为很美好，当然，我们需要更多，"耶鲁大学社会与自然科学教授尼古拉斯·克里斯塔基斯（Nicholas Christakis）说。

sentences.en: "It's possible that this Kindness Mob is creating an opportunity for people to take initial steps towards the more substantial contributions we'll have to make if we're going to correct the deficiencies in our society."
sentences.cn: "这支善意暴徒有可能正在创造一个机会，让人们迈出最初的一步，走向那些更有分量的贡献——如果我们要纠正这个社会的种种缺陷，这些贡献是必须的。"

sentences.en: "On 1 January 2023, I was thinking about momentum," says Brickley.
sentences.cn: "2023年1月1日，我在琢磨'势头'这件事，"布里克利说。

sentences.en: "It just feels like a lot of people leaving negative comments don't really mean it".
sentences.cn: "很多留下恶评的人，感觉并不是真的恶意"。

sentences.en: They're following a crowd.
sentences.cn: 他们只是在跟风。

sentences.en: "That was the lightbulb moment," Brickley says.
sentences.cn: "那就是灵光一现的时刻，"布里克利说。

sentences.en: "I thought, what if I start a channel where I get 10 people in a little club, and we flood the comments with positivity to tip the scales?"
sentences.cn: "我想，要是我开一个频道，拉10个人组成一个小俱乐部，用善意的评论去刷屏，会怎么样？"

sentences.en: Ten was modest.
sentences.cn: 十个人，只是个小起点。

sentences.en: By Brickley's count, he's organised 350 mobs, and the average video gets 1,000 comments.
sentences.cn: 据布里克利统计，他已经组织了350次"围攻"，平均每条视频能收到1000条评论。

sentences.en: Successful posts generate tens of thousands or more, and pull in millions of views.
sentences.cn: 成功的帖子能收到数以万计甚至更多的评论，并带来数百万的浏览量。

sentences.en: In one recent mob, the celebrity socialite Paris Hilton joined in.
sentences.cn: 在最近的一次行动中，名媛帕丽斯·希尔顿（Paris Hilton）也加入了。

sentences.en: Often, the mobsters discover they love the account they're attacking and stick around.
sentences.cn: 很多时候，这些"暴徒"会发现自己喜欢上了被"围攻"的账号，从此留了下来。

sentences.en: It changes people's lives.
sentences.cn: 这会改变人的生活。

sentences.en: Renee Penick, a grandmother from Ohio, US, says she was at her husband's hospital bed when the Mob visited.
sentences.cn: 美国俄亥俄州一位祖母蕾妮·佩尼克（Renee Penick）说，暴徒们"造访"她时，她正守在丈夫的病床边。

sentences.en: It gave her strength in a crisis and built an entire community around her videos.
sentences.cn: 那在危机中给了她力量，并为她的视频建立起一整个社群。

sentences.en: Nocturne, a musician from upstate New York, says the mob brought her so many new fans that she's about to go on tour.
sentences.cn: 来自纽约州北部的音乐人诺克恩（Nocturne）说，那次"围攻"给她带来了太多新粉丝，她即将开启巡演。

sentences.en: After Brickley turned his army on Tigeleiro, she gained so many new followers that TikTok started paying her.
sentences.cn: 布里克利的大军转向蒂格莱罗之后，她涨了太多粉，TikTok 都开始给她付钱了。

sentences.en: She says she made enough money to buy her family a much-needed new car.
sentences.cn: 她说自己赚到的钱足够给家里买一辆急需的新车。

sentences.en: "I dreamed of a better life, and Tyler gave me that chance," Tigeleiro says.
sentences.cn: "我梦想过更好的生活，泰勒给了我这个机会，"蒂格莱罗说。

sentences.en: "I owe it all to him, but he'd disagree with that."
sentences.cn: "这一切都归功于他——但他不会同意这个说法。"

sentences.en: Brickley, meanwhile, goes out of his way to keep the work hidden from the Kindness Mob's targets.
sentences.cn: 而布里克利则刻意让这一切避开"善意暴徒"行动对象的视线。

sentences.en: "We're not the point of the story.
sentences.cn: "我们不是故事的重点。

sentences.en: The point is to remove the distraction, to get all these hateful comments out of the way so the person's content can shine through."
sentences.cn: 重点是移走干扰，把那些恶评统统清开，让这个人的内容得以发光。"

sentences.en: When people talk to me about the darkness that's so familiar online, they describe the internet like a mirror – a system that simply reflects the natural cruelty of the human spirit.
sentences.cn: 当人们跟我谈起网络上那种再熟悉不过的黑暗时，他们把互联网描述成一面镜子——一个只会映照人性天然之恶的系统。

sentences.en: However, Christakis says that's a misread of what's happening on social media.
sentences.cn: 然而克里斯塔基斯说，这是对社交媒体上真实情况的误读。

sentences.en: "Yes, we humans evolved to be mendacious and tribal, and evil and harmful," he says.
sentences.cn: "是的，我们人类在演化中确实变得虚伪而部落化，会作恶、会伤害人，"他说。

sentences.en: "But equally, we evolved to be good; to manifest qualities of love and friendship, and kindness and teaching."
sentences.cn: "但同样地，我们也在演化中变得善良；我们会展现爱、友谊、善意与互助。"

sentences.en: As Christakis argues in his book Blueprint: The Evolutionary Origins of a Good Society, these good qualities must outweigh the bad in our natural state.
sentences.cn: 正如克里斯塔基斯在《蓝图：好社会的演化起源》（Blueprint: The Evolutionary Origins of a Good Society）一书中所论证的，在自然状态下，这些好的品质必定压过坏的。

sentences.en: Otherwise, humans would have learned to live in isolation rather than in societies where we're constantly exposed to each other.
sentences.cn: 否则，人类早该学会离群索居，而不是生活在彼此不断互动的社会里。

sentences.en: "Social media hijacks these ancient, friendly, pro-social qualities", he says, both by introducing anonymity, and through algorithms that highlight conflict and strife to drive engagement and keep us staring at our phones.
sentences.cn: "社交媒体劫持了这些古老的、友善的、亲社会的品质"，他说——一方面引入匿名，另一方面用算法放大冲突与争斗来驱动用户参与，让我们盯着手机不放。

sentences.en: In other words, Christakis says the Kindness Mob's work is sidestepping the perverse influence of social media and encouraging a more "natural" kind of pleasant interaction.
sentences.cn: 换句话说，克里斯塔基斯认为，善意暴徒做的事，是在绕开社交媒体的扭曲影响，鼓励一种更"自然"的愉快互动。

sentences.en: After all, most adults wouldn't waltz into a stranger's house and insult their appearance, the way so many people do in the comments of a video.
sentences.cn: 毕竟，大多数成年人不会径直闯进陌生人的家里羞辱对方的长相——可那么多人每天在网上就这么干。

sentences.en: It could have positive knock-on effects.
sentences.cn: 这可能带来正向的连锁效应。

sentences.en: " We showed experimentally that you can create these cascades of kindness," says Christakis of his research.
sentences.cn: "我们用实验证明：你可以制造出善意的级联，"克里斯塔基斯谈到他的研究时说。

sentences.en: "You are kind to Susie, Susie's kind to Betty, and Betty's kind to Tommy.
sentences.cn: "你对苏茜好，苏茜就对贝蒂好，贝蒂就对汤米好。

sentences.en: So, how Betty treats Tommy depends on how you treated Susie, even though neither you nor I ever interacted with Betty or Tommy."
sentences.cn: 于是，贝蒂怎么对待汤米，取决于你怎么对待苏茜——尽管你和我都从未跟贝蒂或汤米打过交道。"

sentences.en: On an internet that can seem filled with nastiness, Christakis says the Kindness Mob has stumbled onto a solution that's backed by science.
sentences.cn: 在一片看似乌烟瘴气的互联网上，克里斯塔基斯说，善意暴徒误打误撞发现了一个真正重要的东西。

sentences.en: When people stop engaging with trolls and connect with each other instead, research shows that trolls may change their behaviour.
sentences.cn: 研究表明，当人们不再与喷子纠缠、转而彼此联结时，喷子们可能会改变自己的行为。

sentences.en: Someone, however, needs to carry the burden of orchestrating all the kindness.
sentences.cn: 然而，总得有人承担起调度这一切善意的重担。

sentences.en: In September 2025, Brickley's following grew from 30,000 to 200,000 all at once.
sentences.cn: 2025年9月，布里克利的粉丝数一夜之间从3万涨到20万。

sentences.en: "It was very exciting," he says, but it came with a toll.
sentences.cn: "非常振奋，"他说，但代价也随之而来。

sentences.en: "One day I was staring at my phone, and I thought, I just can't do this."
sentences.cn: "有一天我盯着手机，心想：我真的做不动了。"

sentences.en: The project isn't lucrative.
sentences.cn: 这个项目并不赚钱。

sentences.en: TikTok pays accounts with big followings, but in August, Brickley says he made $39 (about £29).
sentences.cn: TikTok 会给大账号付钱，但布里克利说，八月份他只赚了39美元（约29英镑）。

sentences.en: Instead, he's driven by a sense of personal responsibility.
sentences.cn: 驱动他的，是一种个人责任感。

sentences.en: Every day, fans nominate anywhere from 20 to 100 people for potential mobs with a form on the Kindness Mob's website .
sentences.cn: 每天，粉丝通过"善意暴徒"网站上的一张表格，提名20到100个潜在的"围攻"对象。

sentences.en: But the audience's attention is finite and Brickley only posts one mob a day.
sentences.cn: 但受众的注意力是有限的，布里克利每天只发一次"围攻"。

sentences.en: "It means there are 20 people showing up on my doorstep every day," Brickley says, all of them suffering from deliberate cruelty.
sentences.cn: "这意味着每天有20个人站在我家门口，"布里克利说，他们都在遭受蓄意的残忍对待。

sentences.en: "And I have to turn 19 of them away, and the next day there's 20 more." Eventually, the burden was so overwhelming he had to take a few months off.
sentences.cn: "而我不得不把其中19个拒之门外，第二天，又来20个。"最终，这份重担压得他不得不休息了几个月。

sentences.en: To release some of the emotional weight, Brickley had to reframe the project in his mind.
sentences.cn: 为了卸下一些情绪重量，布里克利不得不在心里重新定义这个项目。

sentences.en: He couldn't directly help each person in need, but the mob could pick one each day to use as a lesson.
sentences.cn: 他无法直接帮助每一个需要帮助的人，但暴徒们可以每天挑一个人，当作一堂课来对待。

sentences.en: He also organised some volunteers to share logistical work.
sentences.cn: 他还组织了一些志愿者来分担事务性工作。

sentences.en: "I've been studying internet culture professionally for two decades, and things like this have a very limited shelf life," says professor Alice Marwick, director of research at the Data and Society Research Institute.
sentences.cn: "我研究互联网文化已经二十年了，是拿它当职业来做的，这类事情的生命周期非常有限，"数据与社会研究所（Data and Society Research Institute）研究主任、教授爱丽丝·马威克（Alice Marwick）说。

sentences.en: "Usually, the person behind them gets burned out in a year or two and it goes away."
sentences.cn: "通常，这类项目背后的人会在一两年内被耗竭，然后它就消失了。"

sentences.en: Social media platforms bear a huge responsibility for user behaviour, Marwick says, but you can't just blame algorithms.
sentences.cn: 马威克说，社交媒体平台对用户行为负有巨大责任，但你不能只怪算法。

sentences.en: "What we need is a larger shift in social norms around how we treat people online," she says.
sentences.cn: "我们需要的是社会规范的更大转变——关于我们该如何在网上对待他人，"她说。

sentences.en: "I like the idea of amplifying pro-social behaviour online.
sentences.cn: "我喜欢放大网上亲社会行为的想法。

sentences.en: Whether or not it moves the needle much remains to be seen."
sentences.cn: 至于它能否真正撬动局面，还有待观察。"

sentences.en: Last autumn, Brickley had back surgery.
sentences.cn: 去年秋天，布里克利接受了背部手术。

sentences.en: "When I woke up, my wife was being all cagey and weird.
sentences.cn: "我醒来时，我妻子神神秘秘、怪怪的。

sentences.en: Finally, she said, 'Just check your phone'," he says.
sentences.cn: 最后她说：'你自己看手机吧'，"他说。

sentences.en: She'd stepped outside the hospital room to post a TikTok.
sentences.cn: 她溜出病房，发了一条 TikTok。

sentences.en: Brickley himself was being mobbed.
sentences.cn: 布里克利自己被"围攻"了。

sentences.en: "There were like 1,000 comments.
sentences.cn: "大概有1000条评论。

sentences.en: I was reading through them, just sobbing.
sentences.cn: 我一条条读过去，一直在哭。

sentences.en: Ugly crying," Brickley says.
sentences.cn: 哭得稀里哗啦，"布里克利说。

sentences.en: "I just realised this is real.
sentences.cn: "我只是意识到：这一切是真的。

sentences.en: It can really help.
sentences.cn: 它真的能帮到人。

sentences.en: So many things crystallised for me in that moment." He's gone back to the comments time and again for strength.
sentences.cn: 那一刻，很多事情在我心里豁然开朗。"此后他一次次回到那些评论里汲取力量。

sentences.en: "It feels like a calling," Brickley says.
sentences.cn: "这感觉像是一种使命，"布里克利说。

sentences.en: "The Kindness Mob is just one step.
sentences.cn: "善意暴徒只是第一步。

sentences.en: But kindness, for everyone, always, feels like a good place to start.
sentences.cn: 而善意——给每个人的、永远的善意——感觉像是一个很好的起点。"
